frost_free.name: Frost-free surface at overpass
frost_free.description: Avoid freeze-thaw days; the dielectric jump produces several-dB backscatter artefacts.

no_diurnal_freeze.name: No diurnal freeze cycle
no_diurnal_freeze.description: Daily minimum above 0 — soil dielectric stable across the day.

snow_free.name: Snow-free ground
snow_free.description: Snow cover invalidates vegetation backscatter interpretation.

dry_canopy.name: Dry vegetation canopy
dry_canopy.description: Wet canopy adds 0.5–1 dB noise to crop backscatter time series.

stable_soil_moisture.name: Stable surface soil moisture
stable_soil_moisture.description: Sudden swvl1 change → unstable backscatter baseline.
